scope.question: Is harmful fine-item passage contribution inside GRAM multi-granular FiD distinct enough to justify the preregistered E0-D?
scope.evidence_policy: Official proceedings and primary author preprints; discovery summaries were not final evidence.

claim_boundary.allowed: A GRAM-specific mechanism claim about negative contribution from correct per-history-item fine-text passages relative to the coarse lexical-history passage, structured by oldest/newest position and tail miss/hit.
forbidden: first discovery that extra semantic knowledge can harm recommendation
first adaptive fusion or FiD passage pruning
first causal modeling of behavior sequences

closest_prior_work.overlap: States that uncontrolled LLM world-knowledge fusion can conflict with behavioral signals and selectively incorporates beneficial knowledge with bounded degradation.
closest_prior_work.remaining_difference: It transfers external personalized world knowledge; it does not audit native GRAM coarse/fine history passages or decompose oldest/newest contribution by candidate-failure stratum.

closest_prior_work.overlap: Uses counterfactual reasoning to emphasize the causal effect of the behavior sequence on LLM recommendation.
closest_prior_work.remaining_difference: It contrasts behavior-sequence effects at the task level, not contributions of separately encoded coarse and fine FiD passages.

closest_prior_work.overlap: Masks historical items and reconstructs them to improve generative recommendation history understanding.
closest_prior_work.remaining_difference: The mask is an auxiliary training objective, not a frozen-model counterfactual contribution audit of correct item text.

closest_prior_work.overlap: Establish counterfactual evidence deletion, spurious FiD passage use, multi-granular evidence supervision, and passage pruning in QA.
closest_prior_work.remaining_difference: These are QA evidence systems, not sequential recommendation with a coarse user-history prompt and aligned per-item text passages.

closest_prior_work.overlap: Shows generative recommendation sensitivity to modality choice and develops enhanced late fusion.
closest_prior_work.remaining_difference: It studies modality fusion rather than within-text coarse/fine history contribution or tail miss association.

mechanism_specificity.assessment: No audited recommendation work compares frozen GRAM full versus coarse-only target-path scores to test whether correct per-item text is harmful.

structured_attribution.assessment: No audited work combines cumulative fine contribution, oldest/newest deletion, and tail miss/hit strata in multi-passage generative recommendation.

intervention_room.assessment: No audited work trains a target-free gate from training-only per-history-passage contribution in this structure.
intervention_room.caveat: LWGR already claims harmful semantic-behavior conflict and beneficial-only fusion; RFiD/MGFiD already guide/prune FiD evidence. Any later method must be GRAM-specific and cannot claim generic selective fusion novelty.

decision.reason: The exact structured mechanism audit remains uncovered, while every broad component—counterfactual attribution, history masking, harmful knowledge fusion, and FiD pruning—is prior art.
decision.allowed_next_action: Run only the preregistered frozen-checkpoint E0-D.
